ev.q: the percentage of employed adults who slept <7 hours on average during a 24-hour period increased with the number of hours worked per week
Percentage* of Employed Adults Aged ≥18 Years Who Slept <7 Hours per 24-Hour Period
including 29% among those who worked ≤40 hours, 35% among those who worked 41–60 hours, and 48% among those who worked >60 hours per week
The patterns were similar for men and women.
Estimates were based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population

methods_quotes.q: Estimates were based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population, with 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
